sources.golden_rules_kb: Dixit_Golden_Rules_KB_English_Source_Reconciled_v1_1: Decision Logic (Fruit/Sugar), Ratna-Confirmed Q&A RAG-02 and RAG-17, Golden Rule Core GRC-NEW-8 and GRC-NEW-12

full: Two meals a day, only when you're truly hungry, not by the clock.
Each meal in this order: nuts → salad → sprouts → your usual home-cooked meal, until you feel satisfied, not overfull.
Finish the whole meal within 55 minutes.
Nothing in between meals: anything you eat or drink that starts digestion again counts as a meal.
reminder: Remember the order: nuts → salad → sprouts → your home meal, within 55 minutes.
meal_place: This goes in the last step of your meal, after nuts, salad and sprouts.

amounts.nuts: 4 almonds and 4 walnuts, or a handful of soaked peanuts
amounts.salad: a bowl of raw salad, such as cucumber and tomato
amounts.sprouts: sprouted moong, matki or chole, or 2 boiled eggs, in the same quantity as the salad

nuts.none: The first step of the meal normally uses nuts. Because of your allergy, please ask your Dixit coach what to use instead.

sprouts.suffix: , in the same quantity as the salad
sprouts.none: The sprouts step normally uses sprouted pulses. Because of what you told me, please ask your Dixit coach what to use instead.

rules.statement: Two meals a day, when truly hungry.
Each meal is finished within 55 minutes.
Nothing that starts digestion between the two meals.
Nuts, then salad, then sprouts, then the home meal.
Fruit rules depend on diabetes status (see 'fruit').

non_diabetic.text: For people who have never had diabetes, the programme allows seasonal fruit only within the 55-minute meal window, never between meals.

currently_non_diabetic_unvalidated.text: If you had diabetes and your readings are now normal, the fruit restriction continues until your consultant confirms you no longer have diabetes. A normal reading alone is not enough.

diabetic.text: The programme's fruit rule for people with diabetes: no fruit and no sweets. This changes only when your Dixit expert has checked your results and cleared you.
diabetic.source: KB Decision Logic (Fruit/Sugar); Ratna Q&A RAG-02, RAG-17; Core GRC-NEW-8

prediabetic.text: The programme's fruit rule for people with prediabetes: no fruit and no sweets. This changes only when your Dixit expert has checked your results and cleared you.
prediabetic.source: KB Decision Logic (Fruit/Sugar); Ratna Q&A RAG-02, RAG-17; Core GRC-NEW-8

unknown.text: The programme's fruit rule depends on your diabetes status.

fruit.unknown_rule_text: The programme has a specific fruit rule for this situation, and I can't state it here yet. Please check with your Dixit coach. Nutrition facts below are for information only and are not permission.

positions.vegetable: {food} is allowed in the programme. No vegetable is banned; what changes is how you eat.
positions.starchy_vegetable: {food} is allowed in the programme. No vegetable is banned; what changes is how you eat.
positions.staple: {food} is allowed in the programme as part of your home meal. The programme treats rice and chapati as interchangeable.
positions.dairy: {food} is allowed in the programme as part of your home meal.
positions.nut: Nuts are the first step of each meal in the programme.
positions.egg: Eggs are allowed in the programme; 2 boiled eggs can replace the sprouts step.
positions.sweet: The programme asks you to reduce sugar and sweets.

unknown_position: I can't confirm the programme's rule for {food} yet. Please check with your Dixit coach.
between_meals_unknown: I can't confirm yet what the programme allows between meals. Please check with your Dixit coach.
